name: Clema
tagline: Higher-ed IR data requests plus IPEDS and College Scorecard SQL
description: Clema is an AI analyst for institutional research (IR) and institutional effectiveness teams in U.S. higher education. Its MCP server lets Cline work the IR data request queue (account_details, tickets_list, ticket_details, create_ticket, update_ticket_settings) and query the public IPEDS and College Scorecard datasets with read-only SQL (data_tables, data_dictionary_search, institution_search, data_query). Hosted remote server maintained by Clema, Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 sign-in in the browser, nothing to install. Requires a paid Clema plan; a free trial is available at https://app.clema.ai/sign-up. Docs: https://clema.ai/docs/mcp
